note: One policy for the licence gates. allowed_licences is the WP1-01 allowlist, the same list as the root deny.toml. scan_roots are the trees the marker and provenance scans cover: the spec's crates/, apps/, packages/ and tests/, plus distribution/, examples/, scripts/ and third_party/. Restricted-licence markers (AGPL, GPL, LGPL, MPL, SSPL, BUSL, FSL, commercial) are accepted only in the founder-decision allowlists (docs/orcel/notices/fd06-files.txt, fd04-files.txt; each entry pinned by content SHA-256), in isolated components, or in a marker exception that names the file, pins the marker count per licence family and gives the reason. A file the scan cannot read (binary, archive, over 4 MiB) needs a provenance entry or an unreadable_exceptions entry. npm packages outside allowed_licences are accepted only by a named exception. cargo_fixtures are Cargo projects that cannot carry their own deny.toml. Pins are printed by node scripts/check-agpl-markers.mjs --pins for a reviewed update.
isolated_components_note: An isolated component is a locally operated unit in its own directory (its own Cargo workspace or npm package), never a member of the root Cargo workspace or the root npm workspaces, and never depended on by a crates/* unit (crates/orceld/tests/dependency_direction.rs). Restricted-licence code that cannot enter the core (C-15, C-17; founder decision 2026-11-17) may live only there. Entry shape: {"path": "apps/<name>/", "families": ["AGPL"], "attestation": "<id in donor-provenance.json attestations>", "reason": "..."}. Its donor files still need provenance entries.
